_note: Devnet rehearsal of the payout loop without a market (the Oct 5 loop on the Oct 4 devnet mint): the price is assumed ($1M market cap at 21M supply), a simulated market wallet stands in for trading, and miners' mining is paid from treasury supply. The rehearsal on a real Meteora market uses the config that services/payouts/scripts/devnet-meteora.ts writes; mainnet starts from payouts.mainnet.example.json.
